page.overview:
Who is Chaos?

Chaos is a female Baryonyx and one of the three tertiary antagonists in the second season of the animated series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, as well as a minor character in Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous: Hidden Adventure and the third and fifth seasons.

Chaos is a Baryonyx comprised of blue and grey complexion. Her overall design is closer in resemblance to the individuals featured in .

Chaos cares deeply for her companions Limbo and Grim, as shown when Chaos and Limbo tracked down Grim and Chaos attempted to break her out of a cage she was stuck in. Chaos and Limbo were deeply saddened at Grim's death at the hands of Tiff, and immediately moved to avenge their packmate. While this bond was quite strong, Chaos and Limbo were known to squabble on occasion, even in the midst of a hunt.

Chaos was one of the Baryonyx kept at Jurassic World, where she formed a close bond with other members of her species Limbo and Grim. At some point Grim was taken to a medical center on the island, eventually being abandoned there when the Jurassic World Incident forced the island to be abandoned.
